[element-array]
=== `<array>` Array (Simple Tabular Array)

Used to define a _brief_ tabular arrangement of text in the narrative flow of the document. An array should not be a full table, and does not typically contain a title, caption, or table headings (column heads). Tabular material which does use a label, title, caption, or table headings should be tagged using a table wrapper (<<element-table-wrap,`<table-wrap>`>>) element.

#### Usage/Remarks
##### Best Practice Content of an Array

A NISO STS array (<<element-array,`<array>`>>), unlike the JATS model from which it was derived, may contain either an XHTML Table Body element (<<element-tbody,`<tbody>`>>) or an XHTML Table element (<<element-table,`<table>`>>) to express the rows and columns of the table. NISO STS Best Practice is to prefer <<element-tbody,`<tbody>`>> over <<element-table,`<table>`>> for compatibility with JATS articles, so it is easier to combine standards and articles in a single XML database.
##### Best Practice OASIS Tables

In the NISO STS Extended model, the OASIS XML Exchange (CALS) table model may be used instead of or in addition to the default NISO JATS XHTML-based table model. Best Practice for NISO STS OASIS table users is to use the <<element-oasis-tbody,`<oasis:tbody>`>> element, within their arrays instead of using a full OASIS table element (<<element-oasis-table,`<oasis:table>`>>). A separate Tag Library describing the OASIS table model elements, attributes, and parameter entities may be accessed at: https://jats.nlm.nih.gov/options/OASIS/tag-library/19990315/index.html
#### Display/Formatting Note

An <<element-array,`<array>`>> element is not allowed to float; it is tied to its position in the text. True tables are allowed to float in text or be anchored, as determined by the value of their <<attribute-position,`@position`>> attribute.

#### Description

The following, in order: <<element-editing-instruction,`<editing-instruction>`>> <<element-editing-instruction,Editing Instruction>>, zero or more <<element-label,`<label>`>> <<element-label,Label of a Figure, Reference, Etc.>>, zero or one Any combination of: Accessibility Elements <<element-alt-text,`<alt-text>`>> <<element-alt-text,Alternate Title Text For a Figure, Etc.>> <<element-long-desc,`<long-desc>`>> <<element-long-desc,Long Description>> External Linking Elements <<element-email,`<email>`>> <<element-email,Email Address>> <<element-ext-link,`<ext-link>`>> <<element-ext-link,External Link>> <<element-uri,`<uri>`>> <<element-uri,Uniform Resource Identifier (URI)>> Any combination of: <<element-alternatives,`<alternatives>`>> <<element-alternatives,Alternatives For Processing>> <<element-graphic,`<graphic>`>> <<element-graphic,Graphic>> <<element-media,`<media>`>> <<element-media,Media Object>> <<element-table,`<table>`>> <<element-table,Table (NISO JATS table model)>> <<element-oasis-table,`<oasis:table>`>> <<element-oasis-table,OASIS XML Exchange (CALS) Table>> (In STS Extended ONLY) <<element-tbody,`<tbody>`>> <<element-tbody,Table Body for an XHTML Table>> <<element-oasis-tbody,`<oasis:tbody>`>> <<element-oasis-tbody,Table Body for an OASIS XML Exchange (CALS) Table>> (In STS Extended ONLY) Any combination of: Ownership Elements <<element-attrib,`<attrib>`>> <<element-attrib,Attribution>> <<element-permissions,`<permissions>`>> <<element-permissions,Permissions>>
#### Content Model

[source,xml]
....
<!ELEMENT  array        %array-model;                                >
....
#### Expanded Content Model

((editing-instruction)*, label?, (alt-text | long-desc | email | ext-link | uri)*, (alternatives | graphic | media | table | oasis:table | tbody | oasis:tbody)*, (attrib | permissions)*)

#### Tagged Samples

#### Array using `<tbody>` element

[source,xml]
....
...
<p>Visually inspect the fracture surfaces to establish 
 the nature of the fracture, and assess the type of 
 fracture as follows:
 <array id="tab_g">
  <tbody>
   <tr>
    <td align="left" scope="row" valign="top">A</td>
    <td align="left" valign="top">is cohesive failure of 
     substrate;</td>
   </tr>
   <tr>
    <td align="left" scope="row" valign="top">A/B</td>
    <td align="left" valign="top">is adhesive failure 
     between substrate and first coat;</td>
   </tr>
   <tr>
    <td align="left" scope="row" valign="top">B</td>
    <td align="left" valign="top">is cohesive failure 
     of first coat;</td>
   </tr>
   ...
  </tbody>
 </array>
</p>
...
....
#### Same array tagged with `<table>` element. (Note: This tagging is retained for historical reasons, but using `<tbody>` inside `<array>` is best practice.)

[source,xml]
....
...
<p>Visually inspect the fracture surfaces to establish 
 the nature of the fracture, and assess the type of 
 fracture as follows:
 <array id="tab_g">
  <table rules="groups">
   <col width="9.23%"/>
   <col width="90.77%"/>
   <tbody>
    <tr>
     <td align="left" scope="row" valign="top">A</td>
     <td align="left" valign="top">is cohesive failure of 
      substrate;</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
     <td align="left" scope="row" valign="top">A/B</td>
     <td align="left" valign="top">is adhesive failure 
      between substrate and first coat;</td>
    </tr>
    <tr>
     <td align="left" scope="row" valign="top">B</td>
     <td align="left" valign="top">is cohesive failure 
      of first coat;</td>
    </tr>
    ...
   </tbody>
  </table>
 </array>
</p>
...
....
